definitions.explanation: A ticket purchased from a vending machine at a restaurant that serves as both your order and payment. Very common at ramen shops, gyudon chains, and cafeterias in Japan.

examples.japanese: {食券|しょっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{入口|いりぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{券売機|けんばいき}→券売機：09553_kenbaiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{食券|しょっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: Buy a meal ticket at the vending machine by the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}ったら→入る：00494_hairu⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{食券|しょっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: When you enter a ramen shop, first buy a meal ticket and hand it to the staff.

notes:
A key concept for anyone visiting Japanese restaurants. Many casual eateries — especially ramen shops, ⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧ chains, and ⟦{社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}→社員食堂：19803_shainshokudou⟧ (company cafeterias) — use a ticket vending machine (⟦{券売機|けんばいき}→券売機：09553_kenbaiki⟧) system where you pay for your meal upfront and hand the ticket to the staff.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食券|しょっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a meal ticket
- {食券|しょっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧: to hand over a meal ticket
- {食券|しょっけん}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: meal ticket system
- {食券|しょっけん}⟦{販売機|はんばいき}→販売機：26391_hanbaiki⟧: meal ticket vending machine
